name: How to Use a Smithing Table in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Use a smithing table by placing a smithing template in the left slot, a tool or armor piece in the middle, and a material in the right slot. It upgrades diamond gear to netherite and applies armor trims, with no experience cost and without losing enchantments or durability.
steps: Craft a smithing table with 2 iron ingots across the top row and 4 of any planks filling the two rows below, or steal one from a toolsmith house in a village or from trail ruins.
Get a smithing template: a netherite upgrade from bastion remnant chests, or any armor trim from structures like ancient cities, trail ruins, shipwrecks or trial chambers.
Right-click the smithing table to open its three-slot interface.
Put the smithing template in the left slot. The other slots light up with outlines of what they accept.
Put your diamond tool, weapon or armor piece in the middle slot.

Put the material in the right slot: a netherite ingot to upgrade to netherite, or a trim material (iron, copper, gold, lapis, emerald, diamond, netherite, redstone, amethyst, quartz or resin brick) for a cosmetic trim.
Take the result. Smithing costs no experience levels and keeps all enchantments, custom names and remaining durability.
materials: 2 iron ingots + 4 planks (or find one in a village toolsmith house)
Smithing template (netherite upgrade or armor trim)
Diamond gear to upgrade or armor to trim
Netherite ingot or a trim material
editionNote: The smithing table works identically in Java and Bedrock. It was added in 1.14 as a decoration, gained netherite upgrading in 1.16, and the three-slot template system arrived in 1.20. It is also the job site block that turns an unemployed villager into a toolsmith.

faq.q: Do you need XP to use a smithing table?
faq.a: No. Applying a smithing template at a smithing table costs no experience levels, unlike an anvil. It also preserves enchantments, custom names and durability.

faq.q: Where can you find a smithing table?
faq.a: Smithing tables generate naturally in toolsmith houses in villages and inside trail ruins. You can also craft one with 2 iron ingots and 4 planks.

faq.q: What does a smithing table do in Minecraft?
faq.a: Two things: it upgrades diamond gear to netherite gear using a netherite upgrade template plus a netherite ingot, and it applies decorative armor trims using a trim template plus a trim material.

name: How to Activate a Beacon in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Activate a beacon by placing it on top of a pyramid built from iron, gold, emerald, diamond or netherite blocks, with a clear view of the sky. A 3x3 base (9 blocks) activates level 1; a full 4-level pyramid needs 164 mineral blocks. Then open the beacon and choose a power.
steps: Craft a beacon with 5 glass, 3 obsidian and 1 nether star (dropped by the wither).
Pick an open spot: the beacon needs an unobstructed view of the sky to work, so no opaque blocks above it.
Build the pyramid base under the beacon. Level 1 is a 3x3 layer (9 mineral blocks) directly under it.
Add more layers for more power: a 5x5 layer for level 2 (34 blocks total), a 7x7 layer for level 3 (83 total) and a 9x9 layer for level 4 (164 total).
Use iron, gold, emerald, diamond or netherite blocks in any mix. The block type is purely cosmetic and does not affect the power or range.
Right-click the beacon and insert an iron ingot, gold ingot, emerald, diamond or netherite ingot as payment.
Choose a primary power. At pyramid level 4 you can also pick a secondary power: regeneration or boosting the primary effect to level II.
materials: 9 to 164 mineral blocks (iron, gold, emerald, diamond or netherite, mixed freely)
1 ingot, emerald or diamond to select each power
editionNote: Beacons work the same in Java and Bedrock. The effect range grows with the pyramid level, from 20 blocks at level 1 up to 50 blocks at level 4. If the pyramid is damaged, repair it and the previously selected powers resume automatically. In Bedrock the effect range is also capped by simulation distance, so keep the pyramid inside your simulated chunks.

faq.q: How many blocks do you need for a full beacon?
faq.a: 164 mineral blocks for the full 4-level pyramid: 81 for the 9x9 layer, 49 for the 7x7, 25 for the 5x5 and 9 for the 3x3. That is 2 stacks + 36 blocks, or 1476 ingots.

faq.q: Which block is best for a beacon pyramid?
faq.a: Functionally they are identical, so use whatever you can farm. Iron is the classic choice because iron farms make it renewable. Netherite blocks work too but are wildly expensive.

faq.q: Why won't my beacon activate?
faq.a: Check two things: the beacon must sit on a complete pyramid of valid mineral blocks with no gaps, and it needs a clear line to the sky. Any opaque block above the beacon disables it.

name: How to Make a Brewing Stand in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a brewing stand with 1 blaze rod placed above 3 stone-tier blocks (cobblestone or any variant). You can also find them in village churches, igloo basements and end ships. Fuel it with blaze powder: each powder brews 20 batches.

Kill blazes until one drops a blaze rod. You need at least 1 rod for the stand, but get several: blaze powder (crafted from rods) is the fuel.
Gather 3 stone-tier blocks: regular cobblestone works, and so do its variants like blackstone or cobbled deepslate.
Open a crafting table and place the blaze rod in the top-middle slot with the 3 stone blocks filling the middle row.
Place the brewing stand and right-click it to open the brewing interface.
Add blaze powder to the fuel slot in the top left. One blaze powder fuels 20 brewing batches.
Put water bottles in the three bottom slots and an ingredient (like nether wart) on top. Each brew takes 20 seconds.
materials: 1 blaze rod (from blazes in nether fortresses)
Water bottles and ingredients to brew

faq.q: What fuels a brewing stand?
faq.a: Blaze powder. Add it to the fuel slot in the top left of the interface. Each blaze powder brews 20 batches, and it is only consumed when bottles and an ingredient are in place.

faq.q: Can you find a brewing stand without crafting it?
faq.a: Yes. Brewing stands generate in village churches, in the basement of igloos and in end ships. The end ship ones even come loaded with two Instant Health II potions.

faq.q: How long does brewing take?
faq.a: Each brewing stage takes 20 seconds. Brewing with nether wart to make awkward potions is the first stage for almost every useful potion.

name: How to Get Netherite Scrap in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Get netherite scrap by mining ancient debris in the Nether (most common around Y=16) with a diamond or netherite pickaxe, then smelting it in a furnace. Four scraps plus four gold ingots craft one netherite ingot.
steps: Prepare for the Nether: bring a diamond pickaxe at minimum, fire resistance potions, food and blocks for building bridges.
Travel to Y level 16 or below in the Nether. Ancient debris generates most often around Y=16 and is never naturally exposed to air, so you must dig for it.
Branch mine at Y=15 to keep your feet above the lava lakes that sit at lower levels, or use beds or TNT to blast-mine: ancient debris survives explosions while the netherrack around it does not.
Mine any ancient debris you find with a diamond or netherite pickaxe. Any weaker tool destroys it with no drop.
Smelt each ancient debris in a furnace or blast furnace to get 1 netherite scrap.
Combine 4 netherite scraps with 4 gold ingots in a crafting table (shapeless) to make 1 netherite ingot.
Use the netherite ingot at a smithing table with a netherite upgrade template to upgrade your diamond gear.
materials: Diamond pickaxe or better (anything weaker destroys the debris)
Beds or TNT for blast mining (optional but fast)
editionNote: Ancient debris generates slightly differently in Java and Bedrock, but in both editions the richest level is around Y=16 and it never generates exposed to air. It floats on lava in item form and is immune to fire, so a dropped scrap never burns.

faq.q: What Y level is best for ancient debris?
faq.a: Around Y=16 has the most ancient debris on average in both editions. Mine at Y=15 so the lava lakes below do not flood your tunnels.

faq.q: Can you mine ancient debris with an iron pickaxe?
faq.a: No. Ancient debris only drops when mined with a diamond or netherite pickaxe. Any other tool breaks it with no drop, wasting the block.

faq.q: Is TNT mining for ancient debris worth it?
faq.a: Yes, it is the fastest method. Ancient debris is immune to explosions, so beds or TNT clear huge amounts of netherrack while leaving every debris block intact and easy to spot.

name: How to Make a Potion of Fire Resistance in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Brew a potion of Fire Resistance by adding magma cream to an awkward potion in a brewing stand. It makes you immune to fire and lava for 3 minutes, extendable to 8 minutes with redstone dust.

name: How to Make a Smoker in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a smoker with a furnace surrounded by 4 of any logs, wood or stems (top, bottom, left and right). It cooks food twice as fast as a regular furnace and doubles as the butcher villager's job site block.
steps: Craft a regular furnace first: 8 cobblestone (or blackstone/cobbled deepslate) in a ring on the crafting table.
Gather 4 logs of any type. Stripped logs, wood, hyphae and stems all work too, in any mix.
Open the crafting table and place the furnace in the center slot.
Place the 4 logs directly above, below, left and right of the furnace.
Take the smoker from the output slot.
Place it down and use it like a furnace, but only for food: meat, fish, potatoes and kelp. It cooks each item twice as fast as a normal furnace.
Note the limits: a smoker cannot smelt ores, stone or sand, and it burns fuel at double rate since it cooks at double speed.

Fuel: coal, charcoal, lava buckets or blaze rods

faq.q: What does a smoker do in Minecraft?
faq.a: It cooks food items twice as fast as a regular furnace. Raw beef, porkchops, chicken, fish, potatoes and kelp all work. Ores and other smeltables do not go in a smoker.

faq.q: Is a smoker faster than a furnace?
faq.a: Yes, exactly twice as fast for food: each item cooks in 5 seconds instead of 10. It also consumes fuel twice as fast per second, so the items-per-fuel ratio stays the same.

faq.q: What villager uses a smoker?

faq.q: Do you get XP back from a grindstone?
faq.a: Yes. Disenchanting an item returns experience based on the enchantments removed. Curses cannot be removed, so Curse of Binding and Curse of Vanishing stay.

name: How to Use an Anvil in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Use an anvil by placing an item in the left slot and a repair material, enchanted book or second item in the right slot, then paying the experience cost. It repairs, renames and combines enchantments, but each operation costs more the more an item has been worked, capped at 39 levels.
steps: Craft an anvil with 3 blocks of iron across the top row, 1 iron ingot in the center and 3 iron ingots along the bottom (31 iron ingots total).
Place the anvil and right-click it to open the two-slot interface.
To repair: put the damaged item on the left and its material (iron ingots for iron gear, diamonds for diamond gear) or a matching item on the right.
To enchant: put the item on the left and an enchanted book on the right. The preview shows the result and level cost.
To rename: put any item in and type the new name in the text field.
Take the result and pay the experience levels shown. If the anvil says 'Too Expensive!', the operation needs more than 39 levels and is impossible in survival.
Watch the anvil itself: every use has a 12% chance to degrade it from anvil to chipped to damaged, and a damaged anvil that degrades breaks.
materials: 1 anvil (3 iron blocks + 4 iron ingots, 31 ingots total)
editionNote: Anvils work the same in Java and Bedrock. The prior work penalty doubles each time an item goes through the anvil, which is why gear worked too many times hits the 39-level 'Too Expensive!' wall. Grindstones reset that penalty by stripping enchantments, and Mending gear skips repairs entirely.

faq.q: Why does my anvil say Too Expensive?
faq.a: Every anvil operation on an item raises its prior work penalty, doubling the cost next time. Once the total exceeds 39 experience levels, survival mode refuses the operation. Combine books onto the item in the cheapest order, or reset the item with a grindstone.

faq.q: How do you repair an anvil?
faq.a: You cannot. Anvils degrade as you use them: each use has a 12% chance to move it from anvil to chipped anvil to damaged anvil, and one more degradation breaks it. Craft a new one from 31 iron ingots.

faq.q: Is it better to repair with an anvil or materials?
faq.a: Repairing with materials (ingots, diamonds) costs less penalty growth than merging two items, but combining two damaged items adds their durabilities together. For enchanted gear, Mending plus XP farms beats both.

faq.a: Craft a minecart together with a chest anywhere in the grid. The same pattern works with a hopper, furnace, or TNT for those variants.

faq.q: Why is my minecart so slow?
faq.a: Plain rails do not push carts; without powered rails a cart on flat ground coasts to a stop. Place powered rails regularly (one every 38 normal rails keeps top speed on flat track) and power them with a torch or lever.

faq.q: Can a minecart go uphill?
faq.a: Yes, with powered rails on the slope. Unpowered uphill track stalls the cart and rolls it back down.

keywords: how to make a minecart minecraft

name: How to Make Rails in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 16 rails with 6 iron ingots in two columns and 1 stick in the center. Rails carry minecarts; curves connect automatically, and slopes work without extra ingredients.
steps: Smelt 6 iron ingots.
Craft 1 stick.
Open the crafting table.
Fill the left and right columns with 3 iron ingots each.
Place the stick in the center slot.
Take the 16 rails.
Lay them on top of blocks in a line; they curve at corners and climb one block at a time automatically.
editionNote: The rail recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock and gives 16 rails per craft, so one stack of iron becomes over 170 rails. Abandoned mineshafts are the free alternative: their corridors are lined with rails you can harvest with any pickaxe. Rails can be waterlogged for underwater lines, and a rail always prefers connecting downhill when several connections are possible, which matters for junction design.

faq.q: How many rails does the recipe make in Minecraft?
faq.a: 16 rails per craft from 6 iron ingots and 1 stick. Iron is the limiting factor for long railways, so mineshaft rail harvesting and iron farms pay off fast.

faq.q: How do you make a minecart track turn?
faq.a: Just place rails in an L shape; the corner rail forms automatically. A plain rail connects to any adjacent rail, preferring slopes and south/east directions on ties.

faq.q: Can rails go uphill in Minecraft?
faq.a: Yes, rails climb one block per step with no special ingredients. The cart still needs speed, so mix in powered rails on climbs.

faq.q: Where can you find free rails?
faq.a: Abandoned mineshafts generate with rails along the tunnels, often under chest minecarts. Bring a pickaxe and harvest them; woodland mansions also have a rail room.

relatedLinks.label: How to Make a Redstone Torch

name: How to Make Powered Rails in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 6 powered rails with 6 gold ingots in two columns, 1 stick in the center, and 1 redstone dust at the bottom-center. Powered rails push minecarts when lit by redstone and brake them when unlit.
steps: Smelt 6 gold ingots (badlands and Nether gold are fastest).
Craft 1 stick and mine 1 redstone dust.
Open the crafting table.
Fill the left and right columns with 3 gold ingots each.
Place the stick in the center slot.
Place the redstone dust in the bottom-center slot.
Take the 6 powered rails. Lay them in your track and power them with a redstone torch, lever, or detector rail.
editionNote: The powered rail recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock and yields 6 per craft, so gold farms (zombified piglins) are the long-term rail supply. A lit powered rail accelerates a cart up to the 8 blocks-per-second cap; an unlit one is a hard brake, which stations use to hold carts. On flat ground, one powered rail every 38 normal rails keeps an occupied cart at top speed.

faq.q: How far apart should powered rails be in Minecraft?
faq.a: On flat track, 1 powered rail every 38 normal rails keeps an occupied minecart at full speed. Uphill you need roughly 1 powered rail every 2 to 4 blocks depending on the slope and load.

faq.q: Why does my minecart stop on powered rails?
faq.a: The powered rail is unlit. Power it with a redstone torch underneath or beside it, a lever, or a detector rail earlier in the line. Unlit powered rails act as brakes.

faq.q: What is the difference between powered, detector, and activator rails?
faq.a: Powered rails push or brake carts. Detector rails emit a redstone signal when a cart passes over them, like a pressure plate for tracks. Activator rails trigger the cart itself: eject riders, light TNT carts, or toggle hopper carts.

faq.q: How do you power a powered rail?
faq.a: Any redstone source touching it or the block under it: redstone torch, lever, button, detector rail, or redstone block. One torch powers up to 9 rails in a row.

relatedLinks.label: How to Make a Redstone Torch

keywords: how to make powered rails minecraft

name: How to Make Detector Rails in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 6 detector rails with 6 iron ingots in two columns, a stone pressure plate in the center, and redstone dust below it. A detector rail emits a redstone signal while a minecart sits or passes over it.
steps: Smelt 6 iron ingots.
Craft a stone pressure plate (2 stone side by side).
Mine 1 redstone dust.
Open the crafting table.
Fill the left and right columns with 3 iron ingots each.
Place the stone pressure plate in the center slot and the redstone dust below it.
Take the 6 detector rails. Lay one in your track and wire its output to lamps, note blocks, or powered rails.
editionNote: The detector rail recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock and yields 6 per craft. Think of it as a pressure plate for tracks: it outputs full-strength power while any cart is on it, so it times station stops, switches junctions, and triggers welcome messages. Pairing detector rails with unpowered powered rails is the classic self-launching station: the cart brakes on the dead rail, then the detector rail lights it when you get in.

faq.q: What does a detector rail do in Minecraft?
faq.a: It emits a redstone signal while a minecart is on top of it, full strength regardless of cart type. Use it to detect arrivals, trigger station mechanisms, count laps, or light up trackside displays.

faq.q: How do you make an automatic minecart station?
faq.a: End the track with an unlit powered rail so the cart brakes, put a detector rail next to it wired to that powered rail (plus a button), and the rail lights up to launch you when you board.

faq.q: Detector rail vs activator rail: what is the difference?
faq.a: A detector rail senses the cart and outputs redstone to your wiring. An activator rail acts on the cart itself: ejecting riders, igniting TNT carts, and toggling hopper carts.

faq.q: Does a detector rail work with chest and hopper minecarts?
faq.a: Yes, any minecart variant triggers it at full strength. Comparator-style analog reading of cart fullness is not what it does; for content detection read the cart through a comparator setup instead.

relatedLinks.label: How to Make a Pressure Plate

keywords: how to make detector rails minecraft

name: How to Make Activator Rails in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 6 activator rails with 6 iron ingots in two columns, 2 sticks in the center column, and a redstone torch in the middle. A powered activator rail ejects riders, ignites TNT minecarts, and toggles hopper minecarts.
steps: Smelt 6 iron ingots.
Craft 2 sticks and 1 redstone torch.
Open the crafting table.
Fill the left and right columns with 3 iron ingots each.
Place 1 stick in the top-center and 1 in the bottom-center.
Place the redstone torch in the center slot.
Take the 6 activator rails. Lay one in your track and power it to trigger carts passing over it.
editionNote: The activator rail recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock and yields 6 per craft. Its three jobs: powered, it shakes riders out of the cart (automatic passenger drop-off), primes TNT minecarts to explode, and locks or unlocks hopper minecarts so they stop or resume collecting items. Unpowered activator rails do nothing, and mobs also get ejected, which makes them the standard villager unloading stop.

faq.q: What does an activator rail do in Minecraft?
faq.a: When powered, it ejects players and mobs from the cart passing over it, ignites TNT minecarts, and toggles hopper minecarts between collecting and locked. Unpowered it acts like a plain rail.

faq.q: How do you automatically unload villagers from a minecart?
faq.a: Run the track over a powered activator rail. The rail ejects the villager off the cart onto the spot you designed, no manual breaking needed.

faq.q: Why did my hopper minecart stop collecting items?
faq.a: It crossed a powered activator rail, which locks hopper carts. Cross another powered activator rail to unlock it, or keep activator rails unpowered on collection routes.

faq.q: Activator rail vs detector rail: what is the difference?
faq.a: A detector rail outputs redstone when it senses a cart. An activator rail consumes redstone to act on the cart: eject, ignite, or toggle. Stations often use both together.

relatedLinks.label: How to Make a Redstone Torch

name: How to Make a Trapped Chest in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a trapped chest with 1 chest and 1 tripwire hook anywhere in the crafting grid. It looks like a normal chest but emits a redstone signal while any player has it open, the classic bait for hidden traps and alarms.
steps: Craft a chest with 8 planks in a ring.
Craft a tripwire hook (iron ingot over stick over plank).
Open the crafting table or your 2x2 inventory grid.
Place the chest and the tripwire hook in any two slots, the recipe is shapeless.
Take the trapped chest.
Place it and wire redstone from any side: opening the lid powers the block beneath it and everything touching it while someone looks inside.
materials: 1 tripwire hook (1 iron ingot + 1 stick + 1 plank)
editionNote: The trapped chest recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock. A trapped chest shows a faint red tint around the latch, the only visual giveaway, and two trapped chests side by side form a large trapped chest. Its signal strength grows with the number of players viewing it (up to 15), so a comparator can tell how many people are raiding your loot room. Pair it with TNT, dispensers, or a sticky piston floor for the classic trap.

faq.q: What does a trapped chest do in Minecraft?
faq.a: It works as a normal chest but emits a redstone signal while any player has it open, powering adjacent blocks and redstone dust. It is the standard trigger for chest-activated traps and theft alarms.

faq.q: How can you tell if a chest is trapped in Minecraft?
faq.a: Look at the latch: a trapped chest has a red tint around the clasp where a normal chest is plain. Crouch and check before opening loot in suspicious places.

faq.q: Trapped chest vs ender chest: what is the difference?
faq.a: A trapped chest stores items locally and outputs redstone when opened; an ender chest opens a personal cloud inventory shared across every ender chest and never outputs a signal.

faq.q: Does the trapped chest signal get stronger with more players?
faq.a: Yes. The output equals the number of players currently viewing the chest, capped at 15, so a comparator reading it can count how many people have it open.

relatedLinks.label: How to Make a Tripwire Hook

keywords: how to make a trapped chest minecraft

name: How to Make a Shulker Box in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a shulker box with 2 shulker shells and 1 chest in a vertical line: shell on top, chest in the middle, shell on the bottom. It keeps all 27 item stacks inside when you break it, so it is a backpack you can mine.
steps: Find an End city on the outer End islands (after beating the dragon).
Kill shulkers until you have 2 shulker shells (they drop about half the time, more with Looting).
Craft a chest from 8 planks.
Open the crafting table.
Place 1 shulker shell in the top-center slot.
Place the chest in the center and the second shell in the bottom-center.
Take the shulker box. Fill it, break it with a pickaxe, and everything stays inside for transport.
materials: 2 shulker shells (from shulkers in End cities)
editionNote: The shulker box recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock. A shulker box holds 27 stacks and keeps its contents when broken, making it the core of every endgame inventory system; craft it together with a dye to recolor it, and hoppers can fill and empty placed boxes for automatic storage. In Java, you can see its contents preview by hovering with Shift in the inventory tooltip. Boxes cannot go inside other shulker boxes.

faq.q: What does a shulker box do in Minecraft?
faq.a: It is a portable chest: 27 slots of storage that stays inside the box when you break and carry it. Builders and miners carry several color-coded boxes as expandable inventory.

faq.q: How do you get shulker shells?
faq.a: Shulkers in End cities drop 0-1 shell when killed (50% chance, higher with Looting III). Shulkers also duplicate when a bullet hits another shulker, so farms can breed them.

faq.q: Can you dye a shulker box?
faq.a: Yes. Craft a shulker box together with any dye to recolor it. Dyed boxes are the standard way to color-code storage systems.

faq.q: Can you put a shulker box inside another shulker box?
faq.a: No, shulker boxes cannot nest inside each other, in your inventory or via hoppers. Ender chests are the way to carry boxed storage compactly: fill an ender chest with filled shulker boxes.
