name: How to Make a Smithing Table in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a smithing table with 2 iron ingots and 4 planks of any wood: the 2 ingots in the top-left and top-middle slots, and the 4 planks in the two columns below them. You can also find one in a village toolsmith house.
steps: Smelt iron ore into 2 iron ingots (or loot them from chests).
Turn logs into 4 planks of any wood type.
Open a crafting table.
Place 1 iron ingot in the top-left slot and 1 in the top-middle slot.
Place 2 planks in the middle-left and middle-center slots, and 2 planks in the bottom-left and bottom-center slots (a 2x2 square under the ingots).
Take the smithing table. Use it to upgrade diamond gear to netherite, apply armor trims, or give a villager the toolsmith job.
editionNote: The smithing table recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock. Since 1.20 in both editions, upgrading diamond gear to netherite also requires a Netherite Upgrade smithing template from bastion remnants, and the table applies armor trim templates with materials like gold or amethyst. It is the toolsmith's job site block, and it also generates naturally in trail ruins. Break it with an axe for the fastest pickup.

faq.q: What is a smithing table used for in Minecraft?
faq.a: Three things: upgrading diamond tools, weapons and armor to netherite, applying armor trims for decoration, and assigning the toolsmith profession to an unemployed villager.

faq.q: Do you need a smithing template to use a smithing table?
faq.a: Yes, since the 1.20 update. Netherite upgrades need a Netherite Upgrade template found in bastion remnants, and each armor trim needs its own trim template. The template goes in the left slot, the gear in the middle, and the material on the right.

faq.q: Does upgrading to netherite keep enchantments?
faq.a: Yes. The smithing table keeps all enchantments, the custom name, durability lost and any armor trim, and it costs no experience, unlike an anvil.

keywords: how to make a smithing table

name: How to Make Netherite Armor in Minecraft
quickAnswer: You cannot craft netherite armor directly: upgrade each piece of diamond armor at a smithing table with 1 Netherite Upgrade smithing template (from bastion remnants) and 1 netherite ingot. A full set needs 4 templates, 4 ingots and a full diamond set.
steps: Mine ancient debris in the Nether (best around Y=15) and smelt it into netherite scrap.
Craft netherite ingots: 4 netherite scrap + 4 gold ingots each.
Find a Netherite Upgrade smithing template in a bastion remnant chest.
Duplicate the template if needed: 1 template + 1 netherrack + 7 diamonds makes 2.
Craft or obtain a full set of diamond armor (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots).
Craft a smithing table (2 iron ingots + 4 planks).
Open the smithing table and combine 1 template + 1 diamond armor piece + 1 netherite ingot.
Repeat for all 4 pieces. Enchantments, names and trims carry over to the netherite version.
materials: 4 netherite ingots (16 ancient debris + 16 gold ingots)
4 Netherite Upgrade smithing templates (or 1 plus diamonds and netherrack to duplicate)
editionNote: Upgrading works the same in Java and Bedrock: since 1.20 the Netherite Upgrade template is mandatory in both editions. Each netherite armor piece adds armor toughness and 10% knockback resistance (40% with a full set), and dropped netherite items never burn in fire or lava. Upgrading costs no experience and keeps enchantments, trims, the name and the durability lost. Horses cannot wear netherite armor; the upgrade applies to the four player armor pieces only.

faq.q: How many netherite ingots do you need for full netherite armor?
faq.a: 4 ingots, one per armor piece. That is 16 ancient debris smelted into scrap plus 16 gold ingots.

faq.q: Where do you find the Netherite Upgrade template?
faq.a: Only in bastion remnant chests in the Nether. Once you have one, duplicate it with 7 diamonds and 1 netherrack around it in the crafting grid to get 2 back.

faq.q: Is netherite armor better than diamond?
faq.a: Yes. It has higher durability and armor toughness, each piece gives 10% knockback resistance, and the items float in lava without burning. Enchantments stay on when you upgrade, so enchant the diamond set first.

name: How to Make Stone Bricks in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 4 stone bricks from 4 stone in a 2x2 square on a crafting table, or put 1 stone in a stonecutter for 1 stone brick. Stone comes from smelting cobblestone in a furnace.
steps: Mine cobblestone with any pickaxe.
Smelt the cobblestone in a furnace to get stone.
Open a crafting table.
Place 4 stone in a 2x2 square anywhere in the grid.
Take the 4 stone bricks.
Alternative: place 1 stone in a stonecutter to cut 1 stone brick directly.
materials: 4 stone (smelted from cobblestone), or 1 stone per brick in a stonecutter
editionNote: The 2x2 crafting recipe is identical in Java and Bedrock, and both editions cut stone bricks from stone in a stonecutter. Only Bedrock can also cut them straight from cobblestone, skipping the smelting step. Stone bricks generate naturally in strongholds, igloo basements, cold ocean ruins and some ruined portals, and their variants are easy to make: smelt stone bricks for cracked stone bricks, craft them with vines for mossy stone bricks, and craft 2 stone brick slabs together for chiseled stone bricks.

faq.q: How do you get stone in Minecraft?
faq.a: Smelt cobblestone in a furnace with any fuel. Mining stone directly with a Silk Touch pickaxe also drops stone instead of cobblestone.

faq.q: Can you make stone bricks without a crafting table?
faq.a: Yes, with a stonecutter: 1 stone becomes 1 stone brick, which is more efficient per block than the 4-for-4 crafting recipe and skips the grid entirely. In Bedrock the stonecutter even accepts cobblestone.

faq.q: How do you make cracked and mossy stone bricks?
faq.a: Smelt regular stone bricks in a furnace for cracked stone bricks, and craft stone bricks together with a vine (or a moss block) for mossy stone bricks.

name: How to Make a Torch in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 4 torches with 1 coal (or charcoal) on top of 1 stick anywhere in the crafting grid. Torches give off light level 14, stop hostile mobs from spawning around your base and melt snow and ice nearby.
steps: Get coal by mining coal ore (common in mountains and caves), or make charcoal by smelting a log.
Craft sticks from 2 planks.
Open the crafting grid (your 2x2 inventory grid works).
Place 1 coal or charcoal directly above 1 stick.
Take the 4 torches.
Place them on top or on the side of most solid blocks to light up the area.
editionNote: The torch recipe is identical in Java and Bedrock, and torches can be placed on the top or sides of most solid blocks in both. A regular torch gives light level 14; hostile mobs spawn only at light level 0, so spacing torches every few blocks keeps an area safe. Underwater torches do not work, but torches instantly break gravity blocks like sand and gravel that fall on them, which is the fastest way to mine a gravel pillar. For a dimmer blue light, craft a soul torch with soul soil or soul sand added.

faq.q: How many torches does one coal make?
faq.a: Four torches per coal or charcoal, plus one stick. One stack of coal and a stack of sticks light up an entire early-game base.

faq.q: How far apart should you place torches to stop mobs spawning?
faq.a: Hostile mobs need light level 0 to spawn, and torch light drops one level per block. Leaving about 10-12 blocks between torches on flat ground keeps every spot at level 1 or above.

faq.q: Can torches melt snow and ice?
faq.a: Yes. Snow layers and ice within a few blocks of a torch melt because of its light. Use soul torches, lanterns or hidden lighting if you want to keep ice or snow intact.

name: How to Make an Item Frame in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft an item frame with 8 sticks around 1 leather on a crafting table. It displays any item or block on a wall, floor or ceiling, and putting a map inside shows the map itself, which is how map walls are built.
steps: Get leather by killing cows, horses or other leather-dropping mobs (or from fishing and loot chests).
Craft 8 sticks from planks.
Open a crafting table.
Place the leather in the center slot.
Surround it with 8 sticks, filling every other slot.
Take the item frame and place it on the side, top or bottom of a solid block, then right-click it with the item you want to display.
editionNote: The item frame recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock. Right-click a placed frame to rotate the item in 45-degree steps, which hidden-door builders use as a combination lock signal with redstone comparators. In Java an item frame is an entity and several can share one block space with other frames; in Bedrock it is a block entity. Combine an item frame with a glow ink sac to get a glow item frame that highlights the displayed item, and use an invisibility potion trick (commands or Creative) only if you want the frame itself hidden.

faq.q: How do you put a map in an item frame?
faq.a: Place the item frame on a block, then use the filled map on the frame. The map renders at full block size, and multiple framed maps tile together into a large map wall.

faq.q: Can you rotate items in an item frame?
faq.a: Yes. Interact with the frame after placing the item: each use rotates it 45 degrees. A redstone comparator reads the rotation as a signal strength, which enables item-frame locks.

faq.q: How do you make a glow item frame?
faq.a: Craft a regular item frame, then combine it with a glow ink sac from a glow squid in the crafting grid. The displayed item glows and stays visible in the dark.

keywords: how to make an item frame

name: How to Make a Painting in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a painting with 8 sticks around 1 wool of any color on a crafting table. The wool color does not matter: the picture is chosen at random from all the paintings that fit the space where you place it.
steps: Get 1 wool from a sheep (shear it or kill it) of any color.
Craft 8 sticks from planks.
Open a crafting table.
Place the wool in the center slot.
Surround it with 8 sticks, filling every other slot.
Take the painting and place it on a wall; break and replace it to cycle through random pictures until you get one you like.
editionNote: The painting recipe is identical in Java and Bedrock, and any wool color gives the same random result. The placed picture depends on the free space behind it: a painting can cover up to 4x4 blocks, so clearing a large flat wall lets the biggest pictures appear. Builders hide doors behind paintings because players can walk straight through them. Some special 2x2 paintings are only obtainable with commands or Creative.

faq.q: How do you get a specific painting in Minecraft?
faq.a: The picture is random but limited by the wall space: block off the exact area of the size you want (for example 2x1 or 4x3) so only paintings of that size can appear, then break and replace until the one you want shows up.

faq.q: Can you walk through a painting?
faq.a: Yes. Paintings are non-solid entities, so players and mobs pass through them. A painting over a hidden doorway is a classic secret-entrance trick.

faq.q: Does wool color change the painting?
faq.a: No. Any wool color works and has no effect on which picture appears; that was a common myth from the early versions.

name: How to Make an Armor Stand in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft an armor stand with 6 sticks and 1 smooth stone slab: sticks in the full top row, one stick in the middle, and the smooth stone slab in the bottom-center slot with sticks on either side.
steps: Craft 6 sticks from planks.
Smelt cobblestone into stone, then smelt the stone again into smooth stone.
Craft 3 smooth stone slabs (or cut one with a stonecutter); you only need 1.
Open a crafting table.
Fill the top row with 3 sticks, put 1 stick in the center, and place the smooth stone slab in the bottom-center with sticks to its left and right.
Take the armor stand and place it; right-click it with armor, an elytra or a mob head to display them.
materials: 1 smooth stone slab (smooth stone = cobblestone smelted twice)
editionNote: The armor stand recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock. Java armor stands have no arms by default and can be posed only with commands, while in Bedrock you can change poses directly (sneak + interact) and through redstone power. Stands hold armor sets, mob heads, carved pumpkins and elytra, and they are the standard mannequin for trophy rooms and shops. You can place a stand in 8 orientations, and dispensers can equip them automatically.

faq.q: How do you make an armor stand with arms?
faq.a: In survival Java there is no recipe difference: arms require commands (summon with ShowArms:1b). In Bedrock, armor stands placed normally can be posed with sneak + interact, and command-summoned ones can have arms too.

faq.q: Can an armor stand hold tools or weapons?
faq.a: Only if it has arms (commands or Creative in Java). A normal stand displays armor, elytra, mob heads and carved pumpkins, but nothing in its hands.

faq.q: Do armor stands break?
faq.a: They break in one hit and drop as an item in survival, and water, pistons or explosions can knock them around. They count as entities, so name tags and glow effects work on them.

keywords: how to make an armor stand

name: How to Make a Sign in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 3 signs with 6 matching planks filling the top two rows and 1 stick in the bottom-center slot. Signs display text, label chests and bases, and block water and lava without stopping players.
steps: Turn logs into 6 planks of a single wood type (the wood sets the sign's color).
Craft 1 stick from planks.
Open a crafting table.
Fill the entire top row and middle row with the 6 matching planks.
Place the stick in the bottom-center slot.
Take the 3 signs. Place one, type your text (or write later by right-clicking it), and press Done.
editionNote: The sign recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock and gives 3 signs. Every wood type has its own sign color, including Nether woods, and you can write on both the front and the back of a placed sign. Right-click with a dye to recolor the text, or with a glow ink sac to make it glow. Signs are not washed away by water or lava, which makes them useful for controlling fluid flow in farms, and a honeycomb waxes a sign so its text can never be edited again.

faq.q: How do you edit a sign in Minecraft?
faq.a: Right-click the placed sign to reopen the editor. If the text stops changing, the sign has been waxed with a honeycomb, which locks it permanently. You can also write on the back side by clicking it.

faq.q: Can signs stop water in Minecraft?
faq.a: Yes. Signs, ladders and similar blocks occupy their space without being destroyed by fluids, so players place them to hold back water or lava while still walking through. That is the base of many bubble elevators and mob farms.

faq.q: How many signs do you get from one recipe?
faq.a: Three signs per craft from 6 planks and 1 stick, in both Java and Bedrock.

name: How to Make a Ladder in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 3 ladders with 7 sticks: fill the left and right columns with sticks and put the last stick in the center of the middle row. Ladders let you climb straight up walls and break your fall if you grab them.
steps: Craft 7 sticks from planks (2 planks make 4 sticks).
Open a crafting table.
Fill the entire left column with 3 sticks.
Fill the entire right column with 3 sticks.
Place the last stick in the center slot of the middle row.
Take the 3 ladders and place them on the side of a solid block to climb.
editionNote: The ladder recipe is identical in Java and Bedrock. Entering a ladder's space cancels fall damage even if you are not holding anything, and holding sneak on a ladder stops you in place, which is how players work on tall walls safely. Ladders need a solid block face behind them and cannot float in mid-air; for free-standing vertical access use scaffolding instead, and for water movement use bubble columns. Mobs almost never climb ladders on purpose, so a ladder entrance keeps most of them out.

faq.q: Do ladders stop fall damage in Minecraft?
faq.a: Yes. If you land inside a ladder's block space, your speed resets to climbing speed and you take no fall damage, even from the build limit. Landing on the thin top edge still hurts, so aim for the wall side.

faq.q: Can you place ladders without a wall?
faq.a: No. A ladder must attach to the side of a solid block, unlike scaffolding or vines which can hang in the air. Break the supporting block and the ladder pops off.

faq.q: Ladders or scaffolding, which is better?
faq.a: Scaffolding is faster for building: it stacks from the ground, needs no wall, and you climb it quicker. Ladders are cheaper per height for permanent shafts, look cleaner on walls, and work in tight 1x1 mineshafts.

name: How to Make a Door in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 3 wooden doors with 6 matching planks in two full columns on a crafting table. For an iron door use 6 iron ingots in the same shape; iron doors only open with redstone power.
steps: Turn logs into 6 planks of one wood type (or smelt 6 iron ingots).
Open a crafting table.
Fill the left and middle columns completely with the 6 planks or iron ingots.
Take the 3 doors from the output slot.
Place a door on top of a solid block in a doorway; it must sit on a full block face.
Wooden doors open by hand or redstone; iron doors need a button, lever or pressure plate.
materials: 6 matching planks (any wood) OR 6 iron ingots
editionNote: The door recipe gives 3 doors in both Java and Bedrock, and every wood type (including Nether and pale oak) has its own door texture; copper doors also exist and oxidize like other copper blocks. Wooden doors open by hand and can be used by villagers and piglins, while iron doors need redstone power. On Hard difficulty zombies can break wooden doors down, so iron doors or a raised entrance protect a base at night. Doors also create air pockets underwater, which saves you while mining on the ocean floor.

faq.q: How do you open an iron door in Minecraft?
faq.a: Only with a redstone signal: a button, lever, pressure plate or tripwire placed next to it. Your hand does nothing, which is exactly why iron doors keep mobs (and other players) out.

faq.q: Can zombies break doors?
faq.a: On Hard difficulty, zombies and their variants can smash wooden doors. On Normal they only bang on them. Iron doors and doors placed sideways so 'closed' blocks the doorway are safe.

faq.q: Do doors work underwater?
faq.a: Yes. Placing a door underwater makes a permanent air pocket around it where you can breathe, a classic trick for long underwater mining sessions in Java and Bedrock.

name: How to Make a Fence in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 3 wooden fences with 4 matching planks and 2 sticks: planks in the left and right slots of the middle and bottom rows, sticks down the center. Fences are 1.5 blocks tall, so mobs and players cannot jump over them.
steps: Turn logs into 4 matching planks of one wood type.
Craft 2 sticks from planks.
Open a crafting table.
Place planks in the left and right slots of the middle row and the bottom row.
Place the 2 sticks in the center slots of those rows (a vertical stick line).
Take the 3 fences and place them in a line: they connect into a continuous barrier.
editionNote: The wooden fence recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock, and Nether wood types make crimson and warped fences that do not burn. A nether brick fence uses 4 nether brick blocks plus 2 nether bricks and yields 6. A fence looks one block tall but its collision box is 1.5 blocks, so players and most mobs cannot jump it while you can still see over it. Leashed animals tie to fences, carpets can be placed on top so only you can hop across, and fences join automatically with fence gates.

faq.q: Can mobs jump over fences in Minecraft?
faq.a: No. The fence collision box is 1.5 blocks high, higher than any standard jump, so cows, sheep, zombies and players are all stopped. Spiders can climb over, and a horse with a good jump stat can clear it, so cover animal pens or add a second layer.

faq.q: How do you get animals into a fence pen?
faq.a: Use a fence gate, or place a carpet on top of a fence: you can jump onto the carpet and over, but animals cannot. Leads also work to pull animals in before you close the gap.

faq.q: Do fences connect to walls?
faq.a: Wooden fences connect to each other and to fence gates, but not to solid blocks: a small post forms at the junction. Walls (cobblestone walls) connect to solid blocks and glass panes instead, so many builders mix both.

name: How to Make a Fence Gate in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a fence gate with 4 sticks and 2 matching planks: sticks in the left and right slots of the middle and bottom rows, planks in the two center slots. It opens by hand or redstone and connects to fences automatically.
steps: Turn logs into 2 matching planks of one wood type.
Craft 4 sticks from planks.
Open a crafting table.
Place sticks in the left and right slots of the middle row and the bottom row.
Place the 2 planks in the center slots of those rows.
Take the fence gate and place it between two fences; it matches their height and opens with a right-click.
editionNote: The fence gate recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock and every wood type has its own gate texture. A fence gate opens by hand, redstone power, or pressure plates, and mobs cannot open it, which makes it the standard entrance to animal pens. An open gate has no collision, so players, animals and even items fall through it; builders use open gates as invisible floors in redstone contraptions. It connects visually to fences of any wood type, though matching colors look cleaner.

faq.q: Can mobs open fence gates in Minecraft?
faq.a: No. No mob can open a fence gate, not even villagers or zombies. Only players and redstone signals operate them, so a closed gate keeps animals in and threats out.

faq.q: Why do builders place open fence gates in the air?
faq.a: An open fence gate has no collision box at all but still looks like a block edge. Players walk or fall straight through, so it hides openings in floors, makes secret drop chutes, and works as a one-way door with water.

faq.q: Does a fence gate need the same wood as the fence?
faq.a: No, any combination connects visually and mechanically. Matching wood types simply look better in most builds.

keywords: how to make a fence gate

name: How to Make a Trapdoor in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 2 wooden trapdoors with 6 matching planks filling two rows of the crafting grid. An iron trapdoor uses 4 iron ingots in a 2x2 square and only opens with redstone power.
steps: Turn logs into 6 matching planks of one wood type (or smelt 4 iron ingots).
Open a crafting table.
Fill the middle row and the bottom row completely with the 6 planks (for iron: 4 ingots in a 2x2 square).
Take the 2 trapdoors from the output.
Place a trapdoor on the top or bottom half of a block opening; right-click to flip it open or shut.
Power iron trapdoors with a button, lever or pressure plate.
materials: 6 matching planks (makes 2 wooden trapdoors) OR 4 iron ingots (makes 1 iron trapdoor)
editionNote: The trapdoor recipes are the same in Java and Bedrock: 6 planks give 2 wooden trapdoors and 4 iron ingots give 1 iron trapdoor, and copper trapdoors exist with the usual oxidation stages. Wooden trapdoors open by hand and redstone; iron ones only by redstone. Trapdoors are everywhere in advanced play: they make crawl entrances in Java (open, close onto yourself to start crawling), hide vertical ladders, shade water streams in farms, and act as cheap shutters and shutters for windows. Underwater, an open trapdoor blocks water flow while letting players through.

faq.q: How do you crawl in Minecraft Java?
faq.a: Place a trapdoor at ground level, open it, walk onto the block, then close it onto yourself: you are forced into the 1-block-tall crawling pose and can move through 1-block-high gaps.

faq.q: Can mobs open trapdoors?
faq.a: Wooden trapdoors can be opened by hand, but mobs do not use them intentionally; villagers cannot pathfind through closed ones. Iron trapdoors need redstone, so they are fully mob-proof.

faq.q: Do trapdoors block water?
faq.a: A closed trapdoor blocks water flow, and an open one can hold water back while players slip through sideways. This makes trapdoors the cheapest water gates in farms and aquariums.

name: How to Make a Book and Quill in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a book and quill shapelessly with 1 book, 1 ink sac and 1 feather anywhere in the crafting grid. It is a writable book: type up to 100 pages, sign it to lock the text, and copy or trade it.
steps: Craft a book from 3 paper and 1 leather.
Get an ink sac from a squid (or a glow ink sac from a glow squid).
Get a feather from a chicken.
Open a crafting table (the 2x2 inventory grid works too).
Place the book, ink sac and feather anywhere in the grid: the recipe is shapeless.
Take the book and quill, open it in your hand, write, then press Sign to title and lock it.
editionNote: The book and quill recipe is shapeless and identical in Java and Bedrock. A book and quill holds up to 100 pages (Java) with full text editing until you sign it; signing locks the content forever and lets you title the book. Signed books can be copied in the crafting grid (copies of the original or of a copy, but copies of copies stop working), sold to librarian villagers for emeralds, and placed on lecterns for display. Use formatting codes sparingly: the section sign only works in Bedrock.

faq.q: How do you copy a written book in Minecraft?
faq.a: Craft the signed written book together with one or more empty books and quills in the grid: you get the original back plus copies. Copies marked 'Copy of original' can be copied again; 'Copy of a copy' cannot.

faq.q: Can you edit a book after signing it?
faq.a: No. Signing is permanent: the title and author are set and the text locks. If you might need changes, keep an unsigned master copy and sign only duplicates.

faq.q: What is the page limit of a book and quill?
faq.a: 100 pages in Java and 50 pages in Bedrock, with a character limit per page. Server plugins rarely change this, so split long stories into volumes.

keywords: how to make a book and quill
how to write a book minecraft

name: How to Make a Soul Campfire in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a soul campfire with 3 sticks, 1 soul sand (or soul soil) and 3 logs: stick on top, two sticks flanking the soul sand in the middle row, logs along the bottom. It burns with a blue flame and scares piglins away.
steps: Craft 3 sticks from planks.
Get 1 soul sand or soul soil in the Nether (soul sand valleys are full of it).
Collect 3 logs, stems or wood of any type, including Nether stems.
Open a crafting table.
Place 1 stick in the top-center, soul sand in the center, sticks on either side of it, and the 3 logs along the bottom row.
Take the soul campfire and place it; it burns blue and never spreads fire.
editionNote: The soul campfire recipe mirrors the regular campfire with soul sand or soul soil instead of coal, and it is identical in Java and Bedrock. Soul fire deals double damage per second compared to normal fire, the blue flame gives light level 10 instead of 15, and piglins flee from it, which makes soul campfires the cheapest piglin defense for Nether bases. Crafting one with soul sand and breaking it (drops soul soil) is the only renewable way to farm soul soil. It cooks up to 4 food items at once just like a regular campfire, with no fuel cost. Snow golems are not harmed by it, and bees ignore it unless it is directly under a hive.

faq.q: What is the difference between a campfire and a soul campfire?
faq.a: Soul campfires burn blue, give light level 10 instead of 15, hurt twice as much when you stand in them, and repel piglins. Regular campfires burn orange with light 15. Both cook 4 food items at once and neither spreads fire.

faq.q: Do soul campfires keep piglins away?
faq.a: Yes. Piglins avoid soul fire, so soul campfires, soul torches and soul lanterns around a Nether base keep them at a distance without a fight.

faq.q: How do you get soul soil without a soul campfire?
faq.a: Mine it directly in soul sand valley biomes, or craft a soul campfire with soul sand and break it: it drops soul soil, the only renewable conversion.

keywords: how to make a soul campfire

name: How to Make a Netherite Sword in Minecraft
quickAnswer: You cannot craft a netherite sword directly: upgrade a diamond sword at a smithing table with 1 Netherite Upgrade smithing template (from bastion remnants) and 1 netherite ingot. Enchantments and name carry over for free.
steps: Make or enchant a diamond sword (this is the one that gets upgraded).
Mine ancient debris around Y=15 in the Nether and smelt it into netherite scrap.
Craft a netherite ingot from 4 scrap + 4 gold ingots.
Loot a Netherite Upgrade smithing template from a bastion remnant (duplicate it with 7 diamonds + netherrack if needed).
Craft a smithing table from 2 iron ingots and 4 planks.
Open the smithing table and combine template + diamond sword + netherite ingot.
Take the netherite sword: +1 attack damage over diamond, more durability, and it floats in lava.
materials: 1 netherite ingot (4 ancient debris + 4 gold ingots)
editionNote: The upgrade works the same in Java and Bedrock, and since 1.20 the Netherite Upgrade template is required in both. The netherite sword deals one more attack damage than diamond and has the highest durability of any sword, and the item never burns in fire or lava when dropped. Upgrading keeps all enchantments, the name, and the durability lost, and costs no experience. Sharpness V on the diamond sword first gives the strongest sword possible in survival.

faq.q: Can you craft a netherite sword in a crafting table?
faq.a: No. Netherite gear is never crafted directly: it is an upgrade applied to diamond gear at a smithing table. Any guide showing a netherite sword in a crafting grid is from before the mechanic changed or is simply wrong.

faq.q: How much damage does a netherite sword do?
faq.a: One more point than a diamond sword, with higher durability and better enchantability. With Sharpness V it is the hardest-hitting melee weapon in vanilla survival.

faq.q: Do you lose enchantments when upgrading to netherite?
faq.a: No. The smithing table keeps enchantments, name, trims and prior damage, and the upgrade costs no experience and adds no anvil penalty. Always enchant the diamond sword first.

keywords: how to make a netherite sword

name: How to Make a Sea Lantern in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a sea lantern with 4 prismarine shards and 5 prismarine crystals: crystals in the center and the four edge-midpoints, shards in the corners. It gives light level 15, the maximum in the game, and works underwater.
steps: Find an ocean monument (deep ocean, use a boat and night vision or a dolphin).
Kill guardians and elder guardians for prismarine shards and prismarine crystals; mining the monument's sea lanterns also drops crystals with a normal pickaxe.
Open a crafting table.
Place prismarine crystals in the center slot and the middle slots of each edge.
Place prismarine shards in the 4 corners.
Take the sea lantern; it lights 15, never melts ice, and looks clean in modern builds.
materials: 5 prismarine crystals (from guardians or mined sea lanterns)
editionNote: The sea lantern recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock. Sea lanterns generate inside ocean monuments and underwater ruins, but mining one without Silk Touch only returns prismarine crystals, so crafting is the reliable way to get actual lanterns. At light level 15 they match glowstone and lanterns as the strongest light sources, they are fully waterproof by design, and their animated texture pulses slowly. A conduit-style guardian farm turns them into a fully renewable light source.

faq.q: How do you get prismarine crystals in Minecraft?
faq.a: Guardians and elder guardians drop them, and breaking a sea lantern with any non-Silk Touch tool drops 2-3 crystals (up to 5 with Fortune). Fishing cannot give them; a guardian farm is the fastest source.

faq.q: Can you mine sea lanterns?
faq.a: Only with Silk Touch: without it the block shatters into prismarine crystals and the lantern is lost. For monument raiding, bring Silk Touch or plan to recraft them from shards and crystals.

faq.q: Is a sea lantern better than glowstone?
faq.a: Same light level (15), but sea lanterns are a clean solid block with no dust particles, work perfectly underwater, and suit modern and aquatic builds. Glowstone is easier to get in bulk early; sea lanterns win on looks.

keywords: how to make a sea lantern

name: How to Make an End Crystal in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft an end crystal with 7 glass, 1 eye of ender and 1 ghast tear: glass filling every slot except the center (eye of ender) and the bottom-middle (ghast tear). You need 4 to respawn the ender dragon.
steps: Smelt sand into 7 glass.
Craft an eye of ender from blaze powder + an ender pearl.
Kill a ghast in the Nether for a ghast tear.
Open a crafting table.
Fill every slot with glass except the center (eye of ender) and bottom-middle (ghast tear).
Take the end crystal. Place it on bedrock or obsidian; it explodes if damaged, so handle with care.
materials: 1 eye of ender (blaze powder + ender pearl)
editionNote: The end crystal recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock. Four crystals placed on the edges of the exit portal respawn the ender dragon and rebuild the obsidian towers, and crystals are also the strongest explosive weapon in the game for PvP and speedkilling the dragon itself. A crystal can only be placed on bedrock or obsidian, heals the dragon when lit, and detonates with more power than TNT when hit. Ghast tears are the bottleneck: farm ghasts in soul sand valleys or basalt deltas with a Looting III sword.

faq.q: How many end crystals do you need to respawn the dragon?
faq.a: Four. Place one on the middle of each edge of the bedrock exit portal. The towers regenerate with fresh crystals and the dragon returns; each later kill gives experience and opens a new End gateway, up to 20.

faq.q: Can you use end crystals as a weapon?
faq.a: Yes. Crystals explode when damaged after placement, dealing more damage than TNT, and players chain-place them on obsidian in PvP ('crystal PvP') or to burst the dragon. They hurt the placer too, so blast protection helps.

faq.q: Why can I not place my end crystal?
faq.a: Crystals only sit on bedrock or obsidian blocks. Any other surface rejects the placement, which also means they cannot be moved with pistons.

keywords: how to make an end crystal

name: How to Make Cookies in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 8 cookies with 2 wheat and 1 cocoa bean in a horizontal line: wheat, cocoa bean, wheat. Cocoa beans come from jungle trees, so find a jungle first or trade with a wandering trader.
steps: Harvest 2 wheat from a wheat farm.
Get cocoa beans from cocoa pods growing on jungle tree trunks (break the orange pods).
Open the crafting grid (the 2x2 inventory grid does not fit it; use a crafting table).
Place wheat, cocoa bean, wheat in a horizontal row.
Take the 8 cookies. Each one restores 2 hunger points and is ideal snack food for exploring.
Cookies stack to 64, so they travel well as emergency snacks.
Warning: never feed a cookie to a parrot - cocoa is toxic to them and it kills the parrot instantly (Java) or poisons it (Bedrock).
editionNote: The cookie recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock and yields 8 cookies per craft, the most efficient food per ingredient in the game. Each cookie restores 2 hunger points, so a single cocoa bean and 2 wheat turn into 16 hunger points total. Cocoa beans are the bottleneck: they only grow on jungle logs, but once planted they spread fast. In Java, farmer villagers with the Hero of the Village effect may throw cookies at you as gifts. Feeding cookies to parrots kills them instantly, so keep them away from your birds.

faq.q: Where do you get cocoa beans in Minecraft?
faq.a: Cocoa pods grow on the trunks of jungle trees in jungle biomes. Break mature orange pods for 2-3 beans, then plant them on jungle logs back home for a renewable supply. Wandering traders sometimes sell them too.

faq.q: Are cookies worth making in Minecraft?
faq.a: As bulk food, yes: 8 cookies per craft is the best hunger-per-wheat ratio in the game, though saturation is low. They shine as stackable snack food for caving, not as a steak replacement for boss fights.

faq.q: Can parrots eat cookies?
faq.a: Never feed a cookie to a parrot: it dies instantly in both editions. Cookies are only for players.

faq.q: Are cookies worth making?
faq.a: As your main food, no - 0.4 saturation is among the lowest in the game. As cheap stackable snacks from a wheat surplus, yes: one cocoa bean and two wheat turn into eight quick hunger top-ups.

faq.q: How do I farm cocoa beans?
faq.a: Cocoa pods only grow on jungle logs. Plant beans on the side of jungle wood and they grow through three stages - a green pod drops 1 bean, an orange mature pod drops 2-3. Build a wall of jungle logs for a simple farm.

faq.q: Why do cookies kill parrots?
faq.a: Chocolate is toxic to real parrots, so Mojang made it canon: feeding a cookie to a parrot kills it instantly in Java (astronomical damage) and poisons it in Bedrock. Feed parrots seeds instead.

keywords: how to make cookies minecraft, cookie recipe minecraft, cocoa beans minecraft, minecraft food, cookies parrot

name: How to Make a Pickaxe in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a pickaxe with 3 of your material (planks, cobblestone, iron, gold or diamond) across the top row and 2 sticks down the center column. It is the first tool every survival world needs: without it you cannot mine stone or ores.
steps: Craft 2 sticks from planks.
Gather 3 of your material: planks for wood, cobblestone for stone, or iron/gold/diamond ingots and gems for higher tiers.
Open a crafting table.
Fill the entire top row with the 3 material pieces.
Place 1 stick in the center slot and 1 stick in the bottom-center slot.
Take the pickaxe. Upgrade tiers as you go: wood mines stone, stone mines iron, iron mines diamond.
materials: 3 of one material (planks, cobblestone, copper, iron ingots, gold ingots or diamonds)
editionNote: The pickaxe recipe is the same shape in Java and Bedrock for every tier: wooden, stone, copper, iron, golden and diamond. Netherite is not crafted directly; upgrade a diamond pickaxe at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a Netherite Upgrade template. The tier gates matter: you need stone for iron ore, iron for diamond and gold ore, and diamond or better for obsidian and ancient debris. Golden pickaxes mine fastest of all but break almost immediately, and copper pickaxes (since 1.21.9) sit between stone and iron. Carry a spare: pickaxes break without warning deep in a cave.

faq.q: What pickaxe do you need to mine diamonds?
faq.a: An iron pickaxe or better. Stone and wooden pickaxes break the diamond ore block without dropping anything. The same rule applies to gold ore, redstone, lapis and emerald ore: iron tier minimum.

faq.q: How do you make a netherite pickaxe?
faq.a: Upgrade a diamond pickaxe at a smithing table with 1 netherite ingot and 1 Netherite Upgrade smithing template from a bastion remnant. Enchantments and the name carry over for free.

faq.q: Is a gold pickaxe better than iron?
faq.a: Only in speed: gold mines faster than any other tier and has the best enchantability, but its durability is terrible (32 uses). Iron is the practical workhorse; use gold only for throwaway speed jobs.

name: How to Make an Axe in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft an axe with 3 of your material (planks, cobblestone, iron, gold or diamond) and 2 sticks: two material pieces in the top-left and top-middle, one below them in the middle-left, and sticks down the center column.
steps: Craft 2 sticks from planks.
Gather 3 of your material: planks, cobblestone, copper, iron, gold or diamonds.
Open a crafting table.
Place 2 material pieces in the top-left and top-middle slots.
Place the third piece in the middle-left slot.
Place 2 sticks down the center column (middle-center and bottom-center).
Take the axe. It chops wood fast, strips logs with right-click, and is a hard-hitting weapon in Java.
materials: 3 of one material (planks, cobblestone, copper, iron, gold or diamonds)
editionNote: The axe recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock for all tiers, and netherite axes come from upgrading a diamond axe at a smithing table. Right-clicking a log with an axe strips its bark, and right-clicking copper blocks scrapes off oxidation or wax. In Java an axe is a serious weapon: higher single-hit damage than a sword and it can disable a shield for 5 seconds, though it swings slower. In Bedrock swords stay the better weapon. Efficiency V on a diamond or netherite axe chops wood almost instantly.

faq.q: Is an axe better than a sword in Minecraft?
faq.a: In Java, for single hits: axes hit harder and can disable shields with a sprint attack, but they swing slower, so swords win in long fights. In Bedrock the sword is strictly better as a weapon; axes there are just tools.

faq.q: How do you strip logs in Minecraft?
faq.a: Hold any axe and right-click a log, stem or wood block. Stripped wood is a popular building texture, and the same action scrapes oxidation off copper blocks and removes wax.

faq.q: How do you make a netherite axe?
faq.a: Upgrade a diamond axe at a smithing table with 1 netherite ingot and 1 Netherite Upgrade smithing template from a bastion remnant. Enchantments carry over at no experience cost.

name: How to Make a Shovel in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a shovel with 1 of your material (planks, cobblestone, iron, gold or diamond) in the top-center slot and 2 sticks below it in the center column. It is the cheapest tool to craft and the fastest way to dig dirt, sand and gravel.
steps: Craft 2 sticks from planks.
Get 1 of your material: planks, cobblestone, copper, iron, gold or a diamond.
Open a crafting table.
Place the material in the top-center slot.
Place 2 sticks below it in the center column.
Take the shovel. Use it on grass blocks to make dirt paths, and on snow to collect snowballs.
materials: 1 of one material (planks, cobblestone, copper, iron, gold or a diamond)
editionNote: The shovel recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock for all tiers, and a netherite shovel comes from upgrading a diamond shovel at a smithing table. Right-clicking a grass block, dirt or podzol with a shovel flattens it into a dirt path, the classic village road texture. Shovels dig dirt, sand, gravel, snow, clay and mud at top speed, and mining snow layers drops snowballs for snow golems. Dig gravel with a Fortune III shovel and every block drops flint guaranteed, or use Silk Touch to collect the gravel itself.

faq.q: How do you make a dirt path in Minecraft?
faq.a: Craft any shovel and right-click a grass block, dirt, coarse dirt, podzol or mycelium. The block flattens into a dirt path with its own texture; it stays until you break it or place a block on it.

faq.q: What is the fastest way to get flint?
faq.a: Dig gravel with a Fortune III shovel: every gravel block drops flint guaranteed. Without Fortune, flint is a 10% chance per gravel, and re-placing and re-digging gravel works because each new dig rolls again.

faq.q: Can a shovel collect snow?
faq.a: Yes. Mining snow layers or snow blocks with a shovel drops snowballs (4 per full snow block). Any other tool, or your hand, destroys the snow without drops.

name: How to Make a Hoe in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a hoe with 2 of your material (planks, cobblestone, iron, gold or diamond) in the top-left and top-middle slots and 2 sticks down the center column. Right-click dirt or grass with it to create farmland for crops.
steps: Craft 2 sticks from planks.
Get 2 of your material: planks, cobblestone, copper, iron, gold or diamonds.
Open a crafting table.
Place the 2 material pieces in the top-left and top-middle slots.
Place 2 sticks down the center column.
Take the hoe. Right-click dirt or grass blocks to till them into farmland, then plant seeds; keep water within 4 blocks so the farmland stays hydrated.
materials: 2 of one material (planks, cobblestone, copper, iron, gold or diamonds)
editionNote: The hoe recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock for all tiers, and netherite hoes come from the smithing table. Since the Village and Pillage update the hoe is also the fastest tool for breaking leaves, hay bales, sponges, moss and all sculk blocks, so miners carry one into ancient cities. Tilled farmland reverts to dirt if it dries out or if a mob jumps on it, so fence your fields and keep water nearby. The 'Serious Dedication' advancement asks you to craft a netherite hoe, the classic joke milestone of every survival world.

faq.q: How do you farm in Minecraft?
faq.a: Craft a hoe, right-click dirt or grass near water (within 4 blocks) to make farmland, and plant seeds, carrots, potatoes or beetroot. Farmland within 4 blocks of water stays dark and hydrated, and crops grow fastest in rows with light level 9+.

faq.q: What is the hoe good for besides farming?
faq.a: Breaking certain blocks fast: leaves, hay bales, sponges, moss blocks, shroomlights and every sculk block break quickest with a hoe. For ancient city looting, a diamond hoe is the meta tool.

faq.q: Does farmland need water?
faq.a: Dry farmland works but hydrates nothing: crops grow far slower and the block reverts to dirt if trampled. One water block hydrates a 9x9 square of farmland centered on it.

name: How to Make a Sword in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a sword with 2 of your material (planks, cobblestone, iron, gold or diamond) stacked in the center column and 1 stick at the bottom. Better tiers hit harder and last longer; netherite comes from upgrading diamond at a smithing table.
steps: Craft 1 stick from planks.
Get 2 of your material: planks, cobblestone, copper, iron, gold or diamonds.
Open a crafting table.
Place 1 material piece in the top-center slot and 1 in the middle-center slot.
Place the stick in the bottom-center slot.
Take the sword. In Java, time your swings for full damage; in Bedrock, spam away.
materials: 2 of one material (planks, cobblestone, copper, iron, gold or diamonds)
editionNote: The sword recipe is the same shape in Java and Bedrock for every tier: wooden, stone, copper, iron, golden and diamond, and netherite swords are made by upgrading a diamond sword at a smithing table. Combat differs by edition: Java has attack cooldown, so waiting a moment between hits deals full damage and sprint-knockback hits, while Bedrock lets you swing freely. Swords break cobwebs and bamboo quickly, and a Looting III sword increases mob drops, which is why farmers carry one to every mob farm. Sharpness is the go-to enchantment, with Smite or Bane of Arthropods for specific farms.

faq.q: What is the best sword in Minecraft?
faq.a: A netherite sword with Sharpness V, made by enchanting a diamond sword and upgrading it at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a Netherite Upgrade template. It deals the most damage of any melee weapon in survival.

faq.q: Why does my sword hit softly in Java?
faq.a: The attack cooldown: after each swing a meter refills under your crosshair, and hitting early deals reduced damage. Wait for the full recharge, or use an axe for big single hits. Bedrock has no cooldown.

faq.q: How much damage does a diamond sword do?
faq.a: 7 attack damage in both editions before enchantments; netherite deals 8. With Sharpness V a diamond sword reaches about 10 damage per hit in Java, one of the best early boss weapons.

name: How to Make a Helmet in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a helmet with 5 of your material (leather, iron, gold or diamond): fill the top row and place one piece in the middle-left and middle-right slots, like an upside-down U.
steps: Get 5 of your material: leather, copper, iron ingots, gold ingots or diamonds.
Open a crafting table.
Fill the entire top row with 3 pieces.
Place 1 piece in the middle-left slot and 1 in the middle-right slot, leaving the center empty.
Take the helmet.
Wear it in your helmet slot, and enchant it later with Protection, Respiration or Aqua Affinity for underwater work.
materials: 5 of one material (leather, copper, iron ingots, gold ingots or diamonds)
editionNote: The helmet recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock, and turtle scutes also make the Turtle Shell, a helmet with 10 seconds of water breathing built in. Helmets give 1 to 3 armor points depending on tier, and netherite helmets come from upgrading diamond at a smithing table. Aqua Affinity removes the underwater mining speed penalty and Respiration III plus a Turtle Shell lets you stay under for over a minute. Carved pumpkins also go in the helmet slot: they stop endermen from aggroing when you look at them.

faq.q: How do you breathe underwater in Minecraft?
faq.a: Craft a Turtle Shell from 5 turtle scutes for 10 extra seconds of air, add Respiration III for up to 60 seconds total, and use Aqua Affinity to mine at normal speed. Doors, signs and magma bubble columns also give emergency air pockets.

faq.q: What is the best helmet enchantment?
faq.a: Protection IV for general use, or Aqua Affinity + Respiration III + Unbreaking III + Mending for an underwater setup. Netherite adds knockback resistance on top.

faq.q: Can you put a pumpkin on your head?
faq.a: Yes. A carved pumpkin equips as a helmet and prevents endermen from becoming hostile when you look at them, at the cost of armor and a slightly blocked view. Essential for End trips.

name: How to Make a Chestplate in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a chestplate with 8 of your material (leather, iron, gold or diamond): fill every slot of the crafting grid except the top-middle one. It gives more armor points than any other single piece.
steps: Get 8 of your material: leather, copper, iron ingots, gold ingots or diamonds.
Open a crafting table.
Fill the left and right columns completely (6 pieces).
Fill the middle and bottom slots of the center column (2 pieces), leaving only the top-center empty.
Take the chestplate.
Equip it in your chest slot; it is the biggest single armor boost, so craft it first when materials are tight.
materials: 8 of one material (leather, copper, iron ingots, gold ingots or diamonds)
editionNote: The chestplate recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock and is the most expensive armor piece at 8 material, but it also gives the most protection: up to 8 armor points with diamond or netherite. Netherite chestplates come from upgrading diamond at a smithing table with a Netherite Upgrade template. An elytra replaces the chestplate in the same slot, so endgame players swap between them constantly: elytra for travel, chestplate for fights. Leather chestplates can be dyed any color, and armor trims from smithing templates add cosmetic patterns at the smithing table.

faq.q: What armor piece should I craft first in Minecraft?
faq.a: The chestplate. It costs the most (8 material) but gives the most armor points per piece, so protection-per-ingot is best there if you can afford it, followed by leggings. Boots and helmets are cheap fillers for later.

faq.q: Can you wear an elytra and a chestplate together?
faq.a: No. Both occupy the chest slot, so you choose: elytra for flying or a chestplate for armor. Most players keep both on a hotbar and swap before landing into a fight.

faq.q: How do you dye a chestplate?
faq.a: Only leather armor can be dyed: craft the leather chestplate with any dyes (Java: combine in the grid; Bedrock: use a cauldron of dyed water). Iron, gold, diamond and netherite chestplates cannot change color, but smithing templates add trims.

name: How to Make Leggings in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft leggings with 7 of your material (leather, iron, gold or diamond): fill the top row completely, then the left and right slots of the middle and bottom rows, like a pair of pants.
steps: Get 7 of your material: leather, copper, iron ingots, gold ingots or diamonds.
Open a crafting table.
Fill the entire top row with 3 pieces.
Fill the left and right slots of the middle row.
Fill the left and right slots of the bottom row, leaving the bottom-center empty.
Take the leggings and equip them in your legs slot; they give the second-most armor of any piece.
materials: 7 of one material (leather, copper, iron ingots, gold ingots or diamonds)
editionNote: The leggings recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock and gives up to 6 armor points with diamond, second only to the chestplate. Netherite leggings come from upgrading diamond at a smithing table. Leggings are the piece worth crafting second when materials are tight, after the chestplate. Leather pants protect you from freezing in powder snow, and enchantments like Swift Sneak (found only in ancient cities) only apply to leggings, which is why ancient-city loot runs matter for endgame movement builds.

faq.q: How many diamonds do you need for full armor?
faq.a: 24 diamonds: 8 for the chestplate, 7 for leggings, 5 for the helmet and 4 for boots. The same count works for iron and any other armor tier.

faq.q: What does Swift Sneak do in Minecraft?
faq.a: Swift Sneak III makes you move at 75% of walking speed while sneaking, up from 30%. It is a leggings-only enchantment found as books in ancient city chests, and it cannot be obtained from an enchanting table.

faq.q: Do leather leggings stop freezing?
faq.a: Yes. Any leather armor piece slows powder-snow freezing, and a full leather set makes you immune. Leather boots also let you walk on top of powder snow instead of sinking in.

name: How to Make Boots in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft boots with 4 of your material (leather, iron, gold or diamond): one piece in the middle-left and middle-right slots, and one in the bottom-left and bottom-right slots, like two shoes.
steps: Get 4 of your material: leather, copper, iron ingots, gold ingots or diamonds.
Open a crafting table.
Place 1 piece in the middle-left slot and 1 in the middle-right slot.
Place 1 piece in the bottom-left slot and 1 in the bottom-right slot.
Take the boots and equip them in your feet slot.
Enchant them later with Feather Falling IV: the best boot enchantment in the game.
materials: 4 of one material (leather, copper, iron ingots, gold ingots or diamonds)
editionNote: The boots recipe is the same in Java and Bedrock and is the cheapest armor piece at 4 material. Boots carry some of the strongest enchantments: Feather Falling IV cuts fall damage nearly in half, Depth Strider III makes you swim as fast as you walk, Frost Walker II freezes water into ice as you walk (Java: mutually exclusive with Depth Strider), and Soul Speed III sprints across soul sand. Leather boots let you walk on powder snow without sinking, which is the cheapest mountain-safety gear in the game.

faq.q: What is the best enchantment for boots?
faq.a: Feather Falling IV, which reduces fall damage by up to 48% and stacks with Protection. After that, Depth Strider III for water worlds or Frost Walker II to walk on oceans, plus Unbreaking III and Mending.

faq.q: Can you have Depth Strider and Frost Walker together?
faq.a: No, they are mutually exclusive on the same boots. Depth Strider speeds up swimming; Frost Walker freezes water under your feet. Most players pick Depth Strider for travel and keep Frost Walker on a second pair.

faq.q: How do you walk on powder snow?
faq.a: Wear leather boots: they are the only boots that keep you on top of powder snow instead of sinking. Any leather armor piece also slows the freezing effect once you fall in.

name: How to Make Sticks in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 4 sticks with 2 planks of any wood stacked vertically in the crafting grid, or 1 stick with 2 bamboo. Sticks are the backbone of every tool, torch and weapon recipe in the game.
steps: Punch or chop a tree to get logs.
Turn logs into planks: 1 log makes 4 planks in the 2x2 inventory grid.
Place 2 planks one above the other anywhere in the grid.
Take the 4 sticks.
Alternative in jungles: 2 bamboo in a vertical line make 1 stick.
materials: 2 planks (any wood, mixing types works) OR 2 bamboo
editionNote: The stick recipe is identical in Java and Bedrock and works in the 2x2 inventory grid, no crafting table needed. Any mix of plank types crafts together, which makes leftover planks the usual stick source. Sticks also drop from dead bushes (0-2), all leaves (2% chance), witches (0-6), and fishing junk, and they are sold by fletcher villagers for emeralds, the classic first trade of every emerald economy. You will never craft just one batch: tools, torches, ladders, rails, item frames and campfires all drain sticks constantly.

faq.q: How do you make sticks without trees in Minecraft?
faq.a: Two bamboo stacked vertically make 1 stick, dead bushes in deserts and badlands drop 0-2 sticks when broken, and leaves drop sticks 2% of the time. Witches drop up to 6 sticks on death.

faq.q: What are sticks used for in Minecraft?
faq.a: Nearly every tool and weapon handle (pickaxes, swords, axes...), torches, ladders, rails, levers, item frames, signs, fences, campfires and banners. It is the single most-consumed crafting material in survival.

faq.q: Can you trade sticks with villagers?
faq.a: Yes. Novice fletcher villagers buy 32 sticks for 1 emerald, the cheapest renewable emerald trade in the game and the backbone of most trading-hall economies.

name: How to Make Sugar in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft sugar by placing 1 sugar cane anywhere in the crafting grid: each cane makes 1 sugar, no crafting table needed. A honey bottle makes 3 sugar and returns the empty bottle.
steps: Find sugar cane growing on sand, grass or dirt next to water along rivers and beaches.
Punch the cane: breaking one block drops every piece above it.
Open your 2x2 inventory grid (or a crafting table).
Place 1 sugar cane anywhere in the grid.
Take the sugar: 1 cane makes 1 sugar.
Alternative: 1 honey bottle makes 3 sugar and leaves the empty glass bottle behind.
materials: 1 sugar cane (makes 1 sugar) OR 1 honey bottle (makes 3 sugar)
editionNote: The sugar recipe is shapeless and identical in Java and Bedrock. Sugar is a brewing and baking staple: it goes into cake, pumpkin pie and cookies, brews the Potion of Swiftness, feeds horses for faster growth and taming, and trades to wandering traders. Sugar cane itself is the real farm: plant it on sand, grass, dirt or mud directly touching water and it grows up to 3 blocks tall, and an observer-plus-piston farm harvests it automatically. Honey bottles are the better sugar source once you have a bee farm: 3 sugar per bottle, with the bottle refunded.

faq.q: How do you grow sugar cane in Minecraft?
faq.a: Plant sugar cane on sand, grass, dirt, podzol or mud directly adjacent to a water block. It grows up to 3 blocks tall on its own, needs no light level beyond spawning rules, and bone meal works on it only in Bedrock. Harvest the top two blocks and leave the bottom to regrow.

faq.q: Can you make sugar from honey?
faq.a: Yes. One honey bottle crafts into 3 sugar, and the empty glass bottle stays in the grid for reuse. Use shears on a full bee nest or hive for honeycomb, or a glass bottle for honey bottles, with a campfire underneath to keep the bees calm.

faq.q: What is sugar used for in Minecraft?
faq.a: Cake, pumpkin pie and cookies; brewing Potions of Swiftness (sugar + awkward potion); feeding horses, donkeys and mules to speed up growth and taming; and trades with wandering traders. It is also compostable.

name: How to Make a Note Block in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a note block with 8 planks of any wood surrounding 1 redstone dust in the center. Right-click it to tune the pitch, and power it with redstone to play.
steps: Chop any tree and turn logs into planks: you need 8.
Mine redstone dust from deep redstone ore below Y=16.
Open a crafting table.
Fill every outer slot with planks, leaving the center free.
Place the redstone dust in the center slot.
Take the note block.
editionNote: The note block recipe is identical in Java and Bedrock and accepts any mix of plank types. A note block plays a tone when powered or clicked: right-clicking raises the pitch up to two full octaves, and the block underneath picks the instrument: wood for bass, stone for drums, glass for clicks, wool for guitar, packed mud for flute and more. In Java, putting a player or mob head on top plays that mob's ambient sound, and allays dance to note blocks and drop duplicated items near them. Redstone musicians chain tuned note blocks with repeaters into full songs; survival players use one as a doorbell or a mob-farm alert.

faq.q: How do you change the instrument of a note block?
faq.a: The block directly underneath decides the instrument: wood blocks give bass, stone gives drum sounds, glass gives clicks and sticks, wool gives guitar, packed mud gives flute, honeycomb gives flute-like tones, gold blocks give bells, and a mob or player head on top plays that creature's sound in Java.

faq.q: What do note blocks do with allays?
faq.a: A note block played near an allay makes it drop its carried items at that note block for 30 seconds, the core mechanic of allay item-sorting farms. Wool between the note block and the allay blocks the signal if you need to turn it off.

faq.q: How many notes can a note block play?
faq.a: Two full octaves: right-clicking cycles through 25 pitches from F#3 to F#5. The pitch resets if the block above it is obstructed or if you break and replace the note block.

keywords: how to make a note block in minecraft

name: How to Make Armor in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft a full armor set with 24 units of one material: helmet (5), chestplate (8), leggings (7) and boots (4). Workable materials are leather, iron ingots, gold ingots, diamonds and copper ingots; netherite is made by smithing diamond armor, and chainmail cannot be crafted.
steps: Choose your material. Leather is earliest (kill cows, horses or hoglins), iron is the practical mid-game standard, and diamond is the late-game goal before netherite.
Craft a helmet: place 5 pieces in a helmet shape (top row of 3, middle-left and middle-right) on a crafting table.
Craft a chestplate: fill every slot except the top-middle (8 pieces).
Craft leggings: fill the top row and both side columns, leaving the bottom-middle empty (7 pieces).
Craft boots: place 2 pieces in the middle-left and middle-right and 2 directly below them (4 pieces).
A full set takes 24 pieces of the same material. Mixed sets work but give uneven protection.
Upgrade diamond armor to netherite at a smithing table with a netherite upgrade smithing template and one netherite ingot per piece (netherite upgrade keeps enchantments and trims).
Add armor trims at a smithing table with any trim smithing template plus a crystal or metal (amethyst, copper, diamond, emerald, gold, iron, lapis, quartz, redstone or resin) for looks.
materials: 24 of one material for a full set: leather, iron ingot, gold ingot, diamond or copper ingot
Smithing table + netherite upgrade template + netherite ingots (for netherite upgrades)
editionNote: Crafting recipes are identical in Java and Bedrock. Chainmail armor is uncraftable in both editions (mob drops and village/armorer chest loot only). Wolf armor is a separate item crafted from armadillo scutes and only fits tamed wolves.

faq.q: What is the best armor material in Minecraft?
faq.a: Netherite: the highest protection, toughness and knockback resistance, and it does not burn in lava. Diamond is the best you can craft directly; netherite is a smithing upgrade on top of diamond.

faq.q: Can you craft chainmail armor?
faq.a: No. Chainmail only comes from mob drops (zombies and skeletons that spawn wearing it), trading with armorer villagers, and chest loot.

faq.q: How many diamonds do you need for a full set of armor?
faq.a: 24 diamonds: 5 for the helmet, 8 for the chestplate, 7 for the leggings and 4 for the boots.

faq.q: Is copper armor better than iron?
faq.a: No. Copper armor sits between leather and iron: 10 armor points for a full set versus iron's 15, with lower durability. It is a cheap early-game option when copper is plentiful but iron is not.

keywords: how to make armor in minecraft

name: How to Make a Fermented Spider Eye in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft it shapelessly from 1 spider eye, 1 brown mushroom and 1 sugar placed anywhere in the crafting grid. Fermented spider eyes brew Potions of Weakness, Harming, Slowness and Invisibility by corrupting other potions.
steps: Kill spiders (or cave spiders) at night or in dark places until one drops a spider eye. Witches also drop them occasionally.
Get a brown mushroom: they grow in dark areas like swamps, caves, old growth taiga and the Nether, and you can shear a brown mooshroom for 5 of them.
Craft sugar from sugar cane (1 cane = 1 sugar) at a crafting table or in your 2x2 inventory grid.
Place the spider eye, brown mushroom and sugar anywhere in the crafting grid; the recipe is shapeless, so order does not matter.
Collect the fermented spider eye. It is not edible; its only use is brewing.

Use it in a brewing stand to corrupt potions: a Potion of Poison becomes Harming, Swiftness or Leaping becomes Slowness, Night Vision becomes Invisibility, and it brews a Potion of Weakness directly from a water bottle.
materials: 1 spider eye (spider or cave spider drop)
Crafting grid (2x2 is enough; the recipe is shapeless)
editionNote: The recipe and brewing uses are the same in Java and Bedrock. In both editions the fermented spider eye is the only way to brew a Potion of Weakness without finding one, which makes it essential for curing zombie villagers.

faq.q: What does a fermented spider eye do in Minecraft?
faq.a: It corrupts potions in a brewing stand. Poison becomes Harming, Swiftness and Leaping become Slowness, Healing becomes Harming, Night Vision becomes Invisibility, and a plain water bottle becomes a Potion of Weakness.

faq.q: Can you eat a fermented spider eye?
faq.a: No. Unlike a regular spider eye, it cannot be eaten at all. Its only purpose is brewing.

faq.q: How do you get a brown mushroom?
faq.a: Brown mushrooms generate in dark spots: swamps, caves, old growth taiga, mushroom fields, and everywhere in the Nether. Shearing a brown mooshroom gives 5 brown mushrooms.

faq.q: Do you need a fermented spider eye to cure a zombie villager?
faq.a: Yes, in practice: curing requires a Splash Potion of Weakness plus a golden apple, and brewing Weakness from a water bottle needs a fermented spider eye (no blaze powder required for that one).

name: How to Spawn the Wither in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Build a T shape with 4 soul sand or soul soil blocks and place 3 wither skeleton skulls on top - the last block placed must be a skull. It works in any dimension. The wither has 300 HP in Java and up to 600 on Hard in Bedrock.
steps: Collect 4 soul sand or soul soil from the Nether (soul sand valleys are the easiest source).
Get 3 wither skeleton skulls: kill wither skeletons in Nether fortresses. The base drop chance is 2.5%; Looting III raises it to 5.5%.
Pick your arena carefully: a flat area far from your base, the classic trap under the End's exit-fountain bedrock, or a cave ceiling in the deepslate layer.
Place the T: 3 soul sand in a horizontal row with 1 more stacked on the center block (or upright, 3 high with 2 arms).
Place the 3 wither skeleton skulls on the three top blocks. The final block placed must be a skull, placed by hand or by a dispenser; pistons cannot assemble the structure for you.
Step back immediately: the wither flashes white for about 10 seconds, grows, and then detonates in a massive explosion (bigger than TNT or a charged creeper).
Fight it under cover: it fires explosive skulls that inflict Wither II (your health bar turns black and drains). In Bedrock it also dashes and spawns 3-4 wither skeletons at half health.
Kill it to get 1 nether star (always) - the key ingredient for a beacon.
The build works upright, sideways or upside-down, but the two blocks beside the base must be air, and nothing spawns on Peaceful difficulty.
materials: 3 wither skeleton skulls (wither skeletons in Nether fortresses; Looting III helps)
Optional: Strength/Regeneration potions, Smite V sword or Power V bow, golden apples, milk
4 soul sand or soul soil (soul sand valleys in the Nether)
3 wither skeleton skulls (wither skeletons in Nether fortresses)
Optional: a dispenser to place the last skull from a safe distance
editionNote: Health differs by edition: 300 HP always in Java; 300 on Easy, 450 on Normal and 600 on Hard in Bedrock. Bedrock also gives the wither a dash attack, a half-health explosion, and it spawns wither skeletons at half health (except on Easy). In Bedrock it can be spawned by dispensers; in Java it cannot.

faq.q: Can you spawn the wither in the End or Overworld?
faq.a: Yes, in any dimension. The classic safe spot is under the bedrock fountain in the End, which pins it in place.

faq.q: What is the drop rate for wither skeleton skulls?
faq.a: 2.5% base, raised by Looting to a maximum of 5.5% with Looting III (Java). Expect to kill dozens of wither skeletons per skull without Looting.

faq.q: Can pistons or dispensers build the wither for you?
faq.a: Pistons cannot: pushed blocks never trigger the structure. A dispenser CAN place the final skull, which is how automated wither setups work.

faq.q: What does the wither drop?
faq.a: Always 1 nether star (used to craft a beacon) plus 50 XP. In Bedrock, wither roses can appear where its attacks kill mobs.

faq.q: Why won't my wither spawn?
faq.a: Three common causes: the last block placed was not a skull, the two spaces beside the base block are not air, or you are on Peaceful difficulty. Double-check all three and it goes up instantly.

faq.q: Where should I summon the wither?
faq.a: Anywhere far from your builds - a remote desert, a deep cave, or a purpose-built bedrock cage under the End exit portal or on the Nether ceiling for safe farming. Never at home: the spawn explosion and skull barrage flatten everything.

name: How to Make Glass Panes in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Craft 16 glass panes from 6 glass blocks filling the bottom two rows of the crafting grid. Smelt sand or red sand in a furnace to get the glass first.
steps: Smelt sand or red sand in a furnace or blast furnace with any fuel: 1 sand gives 1 glass.
Collect at least 6 glass blocks for one batch of panes.
Open a crafting table and fill the bottom two rows completely with 6 glass blocks.
Take the 16 glass panes from the result slot - each batch of 6 glass makes 16 panes.
Use panes for windows: they are far cheaper than full blocks (1 pane costs 0.375 glass) and connect into thin transparent walls.
Stained glass panes: stain the glass blocks first (8 glass around 1 dye), then craft those into panes; panes cannot be dyed directly.
materials: 6 glass blocks (from smelting sand or red sand)
editionNote: The recipe is identical in Java and Bedrock: 6 glass to 16 panes. In both editions, glass panes drop nothing when broken without Silk Touch, same as glass blocks.

faq.q: How many glass panes does 6 glass make?
faq.a: 16 panes. Since a full window pane wall uses 1 pane per block position, panes are almost 3 times more efficient than full glass blocks.

faq.q: Do glass panes drop when broken?
faq.a: Only with a Silk Touch tool. Otherwise they shatter and drop nothing, same as glass blocks.

faq.q: Can you dye glass panes?
faq.a: Not directly. Dye the glass blocks into stained glass first (8 glass around 1 dye), then craft those into stained glass panes.

faq.q: What connects to glass panes?
faq.a: Panes connect to solid blocks and other panes on their sides, forming thin cross or line shapes. They do not connect diagonally or to the top and bottom of blocks.

name: How to Make Bricks in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Smelt clay balls in a regular furnace to make brick items, then put four brick items in a 2×2 square to make one brick block. A blast furnace cannot smelt clay. Breaking one clay block gives the four balls needed for one brick block.
steps: Collect clay from shallow water or lush cave ponds. A shovel is fastest.
Break each clay block without Silk Touch to get four clay balls. Fortune does not increase this drop.
Smelt the balls in a regular furnace with fuel: one clay ball makes one brick item. A blast furnace does not work.
Put four brick items in a 2×2 square in your inventory or a crafting table to make one brick block.
Use finished brick blocks in a stonecutter for stairs, slabs or walls. Mine placed brick blocks with any pickaxe.
Keep individual brick items for flower pots: three in a V shape make one pot.
materials: Any pickaxe to recover placed brick blocks
editionNote: The clay-to-brick recipe works in Java and Bedrock. Clay balls make brick items; whole clay blocks smelt into terracotta instead. Novice mason villagers also sell brick items, not finished brick blocks.

faq.q: Can a blast furnace make bricks?
faq.a: No. Use a regular furnace. A blast furnace does not accept clay balls.

faq.q: How much clay makes 64 brick blocks?
faq.a: 64 clay blocks drop 256 clay balls. Smelt all 256 balls into brick items, then craft them into 64 brick blocks.

faq.q: Do masons sell brick blocks?
faq.a: They sell individual brick items at novice level. Craft four items together to make a block.

faq.q: Why did my clay become terracotta?
faq.a: You smelted a whole clay block. Break the block into clay balls first if you want bricks.

name: How to Use an Enchanted Book in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Place the item and the enchanted book in an anvil: the item goes in the left slot, the book in the middle, and you pay the XP level cost shown on the right. Books can also combine with other books to stack enchantments or raise their level.
steps: Craft or find an anvil: 3 iron blocks + 4 iron ingots (31 iron total). Enchanted books come from fishing, chest loot, raids, bartering with piglins (Soul Speed), or librarian villager trades.
Place the anvil and right-click it. Put the item you want to enchant in the left slot.
Put the enchanted book in the middle slot. The right slot shows the result and its XP level cost; survival mode caps costs at 39 levels ('Too Expensive!' beyond that).
Take the enchanted item. Each use of an anvil makes the next anvil operation on that item cost more, so combine books first and apply them in as few operations as possible.

Combine books with books: two Protection I books make one Protection II book. Two identical enchantments of the same level always combine up one level, or add together different compatible enchantments.

Respect incompatibilities: Sharpness, Smite and Bane of Arthropods exclude each other; the four Protection types exclude each other; Fortune and Silk Touch exclude each other; Mending and Infinity exclude each other.
materials: The tool, weapon or armor to enchant
XP levels (cost shown on the anvil)
editionNote: Anvil mechanics work the same in Java and Bedrock, including the 39-level survival cap. Treasure enchantments like Mending never appear on the enchanting table in either edition; books are the way to get them.

faq.q: Why does my anvil say Too Expensive?
faq.a: Survival mode caps anvil operations at 39 XP levels. Costs grow with every prior anvil use on the item, so combine books before applying them and enchant fresh gear rather than reworking old pieces.

faq.q: How do you get Mending on an item?
faq.a: Mending is a treasure enchantment: it never comes from the enchanting table. Get a Mending book from librarian villagers, fishing, or chest loot, then apply it on an anvil.

faq.q: Can you combine two different enchanted books?
faq.a: Yes. Different compatible enchantments merge into one book, and two books with the same enchantment and level combine into the next level (two Unbreaking II books make Unbreaking III).

faq.q: Do enchanted books work on any item?
faq.a: Only on items that accept that enchantment. You cannot put Sharpness on a pickaxe through an anvil, and Silk Touch will not go on a sword.

name: How to Make Blaze Powder in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Put 1 blaze rod anywhere in the crafting grid to get 2 blaze powder. Blaze rods drop from blazes, which spawn in Nether fortresses, often from spawners inside them.
steps: Build a Nether portal and enter the Nether with iron armor or better and a shield.
Find a Nether fortress: the long dark-brick structures. They generate in strips along the east-west axis, so travel north or south to bump into one.
Locate blazes: they spawn around the fortress and from blaze spawners, usually in open-air rooms with fences or small enclosed rooms.
Kill blazes until you have the rods you need. Each blaze drops 0-1 blaze rods (more with Looting); snowballs hurt them, and fire resistance potions make the farm safe.
Place 1 blaze rod in any crafting slot to get 2 blaze powder. No crafting table needed; the 2x2 inventory grid works.

Use it: blaze powder fuels brewing stands (each powder lasts 20 operations), combines with an ender pearl into an eye of ender, with a slimeball into magma cream, and with coal and gunpowder into fire charges.
materials: Blaze rods (from blazes in Nether fortresses)
editionNote: The recipe and uses are the same in Java and Bedrock. In both editions one blaze rod always yields exactly 2 blaze powder, shapeless.

faq.q: Can you get blaze powder without going to the Nether?
faq.a: No reliable way: blaze powder only comes from blaze rods, and blaze rods only come from blazes, which only spawn in Nether fortresses.

faq.q: How many blaze powders does a brewing stand use?
faq.a: Each blaze powder placed as fuel powers 20 brewing operations, and a stand holds up to 20 powder at once.

faq.q: What is the fastest way to farm blaze rods?
faq.a: Find a blaze spawner inside a fortress, build a safe platform, and use a fire resistance potion plus a Looting III sword. Snowballs also work: they damage blazes and stack.

faq.q: What do you need blaze powder for to beat the game?

name: How to Make Terracotta in Minecraft
quickAnswer: Smelt a clay block in a furnace to get terracotta. Dye it by surrounding 1 dye with 8 terracotta, and smelt dyed terracotta again to get patterned glazed terracotta. Badlands biomes have huge natural deposits.
steps: Get clay blocks: dig them up underwater in rivers, swamps and lakes, or from lush caves. Silk Touch gives the block directly; otherwise craft 4 clay balls back into a block.
Smelt each clay block in a furnace with any fuel: 1 clay block gives 1 terracotta (the undyed, reddish kind).
Dye it: place 8 terracotta around 1 dye on a crafting table for 8 dyed terracotta of that color. All 16 dye colors work.
Glaze it: smelt any dyed terracotta again in a furnace to get glazed terracotta with a unique pattern per color.
Skip the crafting entirely in the badlands (mesa): the biome is made of terracotta in many colors, so just mine it with any pickaxe.

editionNote: The smelting and dyeing recipes are identical in Java and Bedrock, including 8 terracotta per dye. Badlands biomes generate with the same terracotta layers in both editions.
